question: The book titled 'My Journey: Transforming Dreams into Actions' is an autobiography of:
solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**APJ Abdul Kalam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The book titled 'My Journey: Transforming Dreams into Actions' is **____**an autobiography​**____** of **__APJ Abdul Kalam.
 
• **Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam **was an Indian aerospace scientist who served as the 11th president of India from 2002 to 2007.
 __
 
• He was born and raised in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, and studied physics and aerospace engineering.
 
• He spent the next four decades as a scientist and science administrator, mainly at the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), and was intimately involved in India's civilian space program and military missile development efforts.
 
• He thus came to be known as the **Missile Man of India** for his work on the development of ballistic missiles and launch vehicle technology.
 
• He also played a pivotal organizational, technical, and political role in India's Pokhran-II nuclear tests in 1998, the first since the original nuclear test by India in **1974**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pratibha Devisingh Patil** is an Indian politician and lawyer who served as the 12th president of India from 25 July 2007 to July 2012.

 
 
• A member of the Indian National Congress, Patil is the only woman to have held the office.
 
• She had previously served as the Governor of Rajasthan from 2004 to 2007.
 
 
 
• **Atal Bihari Vajpayee** was an Indian politician who served three terms as the prime minister of India, first for a term of 13 days in 1996, then for a period of 13 months from 1998 to 1999, followed by a full term from 1999 to 2004.
 
 
• Vajpayee was one of the co-founders and a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party. 
 
 
 
• **Lal Krishna Advani** is an Indian politician who served as the 7th Deputy Prime Minister of India from 2002 to 2004.
 
 
• Advani is one of the co-founders and a senior leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party.
 
• He is a longtime member of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh, a volunteer organization.
